### Tier 2 — live regression (free, via the build's own HO chain)

      (proves implement mode on the modified enum/switch/verdict files)
- [ ] The derived code_review HO is dispatched and `delivered` (proves code_review mode)

### Tier 3 — post-merge live gate (all three families)

      (deepseek via `openrouter-oss`)** — against a real exploration subject; each run:
      admission passes, verdict `delivered`, advisory path reports `no_changes`
      (no stray mutations), recovery block parses valid with `reported_role: "explorer"`
- [ ] Gate dispatches pass explicit `--model`/`--backend` (HO-0064 F5: multi-model
      `use_for` tags make mode-default resolution refuse `AMBIGUOUS_MODEL_DEFAULT` /
      `NO_MODEL_DEFAULT` — defaults must not be relied on)

# PLN-0004 S3 — Rulings (operator-ratified 2026-09-07..10, frozen 2026-09-10) The nine open S3 decisions (D0–D8), walked and ruled in `execution/s3-open-decisions.md` (full options/facts/rationale live THERE; this doc is the binding freeze + build decomposition). The build has NOT started — the S3 execution session cold-starts from the tracker plus this file. Code facts below verified by a 2-subagent read-only sweep of `main` (post-S1/S2 state) on 2026-09-10. ## Rulings (net effect — supersessions already applied) 1. **Two-table repo-local registry; explicit `--model --backend `, both required (D0/D2).** `wiki/.dispatch/` in the consuming repo holds `models.json` (slug → available_on → per-backend model_id, + notes), `backends.json` (name → base_url, api_key_env|null, secrets_file|null, + notes), `profiles.json` (schema_version 1 + inject profiles). ALL ship blank (`{}` / `{"schema_version":1}`); kb ships NO seed entries — a kb-managed README carries copy-pasteable examples. `available_on` mismatch = warn, never refuse. Malformed models/backends JSON = loud refusal at dispatch naming file + parse error; malformed profiles.json refuses credentialed dispatches only. Absent dir/files = valid empty state, guidance names `init-dispatch`. Multi-backend models: MCP instructions say ask the operator — no defaulting. 2. **Model keys are backend-owned infrastructure (D0).** Injection is SELECTIVE: only the resolved backend's `api_key_env` (from its `secrets_file`) plus granted profiles' `inject` vars reach the worker. The S0 blanket `set -a; source secrets.env` block (pipeline.ts:199-204) is retired. HO `credentials:` = task credentials only; model keys never trip the credentials+web hard stop. 3. **No preflight probes (D1).** kb never executes credential commands. Declarative existence checks only: profile exists in profiles.json, inject var present in its named file (checked Linux-side, reported set/unset, value never printed), refusing `CREDENTIAL_NOT_CONFIGURED` / `UNKNOWN_PROFILE` pre-spawn. Liveness is the orchestrator/operator's job; MCP instructions say so. 4. **profiles.json IS the policy (D3).** No policy file. `UNKNOWN_PROFILE` lands at S3. `MODE_NOT_ALLOWED_FOR_PROFILE` is DROPPED — superseded by D8's removal of `allowed_modes` (no field to key off); the credentials+web hard stop (`CREDENTIALS_WITH_WEB`, spec §7.6) covers the real case. Spec §7.7 / S4 14-check count delta recorded in the tracker (T14 note). 5. **profiles.json schema frozen (D8).** `schema_version: 1`; profile = `{ "inject": { "VAR_NAME": "/path/to/file" } }`. Strict validation: unknown keys refuse, naming the key. New handoff field `vars` (non-secret literal env for the worker — contract addition; refuse on any `vars` key colliding with an injected/api_key var name). No `mounts`, no `allowed_modes`, no `preflight` in profiles. `data_mounts` = non-credential data only (S5 enforcement). 6. **Cloud credential isolation = operator-mediated short-lived creds; kb stays cloud-ignorant (D8, 2026-09-10).** `aws configure export-credentials --profile

--format env-no-export > <0600 file outside every repo>` → plain `inject` profile. `--profile` pins the named non-superuser profile; the no-profile default chain (on EC2, the instance role) is also acceptable when used deliberately. GCP later: `gcloud auth print-access-token`, same shape. No INI/SSO-cache parsing, no STS calls in kb, ever; STS hardening stays spec §15-deferred (trigger: first real AWS/GCP need — planned work-surface test via cloned kb on already-bootstrapped repos). 7. **Version gate (D5).** In-code harness constant `{package: '@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent', testedWith: '0.85.1', knownGood, installCmd}` — kb's only compatibility claim, shipped with kb code, NOT a `wiki/.dispatch` file (post-D2 amendment). `PI_VERSION=$(pi --version)` rides the existing preflight script (KEY=value convention); below knownGood → refuse printing installCmd; above testedWith → warn + proceed + stamp; unprobeable/unparseable → refuse (fail-closed). # Explorer report — HO-0082: model-registry.ts public API and resolution logic

**Subject:** `packages/dispatch-core/src/model-registry.ts` (474 lines) — dispatch v2 two-table model registry (PLN-0004 S3 Wave 2b), harness version gate, backend fingerprint.

**Verdict:** The module is in good shape and well-tested (46/46 targeted tests pass live). Findings are non-blocking: 2 low + 2 info.

## 1. Public API surface

**Types** (all exported from the module; `ModelEntry`/`ModelRegistry`/`ResolvedModel`/`VersionGateResult`/`BackendFingerprint` re-exported from the `index.ts` barrel):
- `ModelEntry` / `ModelRegistry` (line 26/40) — legacy S0 seed shape, still consumed as a *type* by `adapters/pi.ts`, `environment.ts`, `pipeline.ts`.
- `ResolvedModel` (line 101) — `{slug, backend, family, modelId, baseUrl, apiKeyEnv, secretsFile, availableOn, effortMapping?, contextWindow, requestParams?}`.
- `VersionGateResult` (`ok|warn|refuse`), `BackendFingerprint` (`{serverVersion, host, model}`).

**Constants:** `DEFAULT_CONTEXT_WINDOW = 131072` (line 126), `MIN_CONTEXT_WINDOW = 32768` (line 137, = 2× Pi's 16384 compaction reserve, verified against Pi 0.85.1 `compaction.js:160-163`), `PI_HARNESS_INFO = {package: '@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent', testedWith: '0.85.1', knownGood: '0.85.0', installCmd}`.

**Functions:**
| Export | Purpose | Barrel? |
|---|---|---|
| `getDefaultRegistry()`, `resolveModel(registry, alias)` | S0 seed, deprecated | yes |
| `resolveModelFromConfig(dir, slug, backend)` | explicit two-table resolution | yes |
| `resolveModelByMode(dir, mode)` | both flags omitted → `use_for` mode default | yes |
| `resolveModelInferBackend(dir, slug)` | model-only → infer sole backend | **no** |
| `gatePiPresence(family, piVersion, installCmd?)` | refuse pi-family with pi missing | **no** |
| `checkHarnessVersion(versionString)` | version gate (fails closed) | yes |
| `buildFingerprintFragment(resolvedModel)`, `parseFingerprintOutput(stdout)` | backend probe (never gating) | yes |

## 2. Resolution logic — default vs explicit dispatch

`dispatch-background.ts:231-256` implements the precedence ladder: **explicit wins → model-only infers backend → both omitted resolves by HO `mode` → backend-only errors `BAD_RECORD`** showing a usage message. The direct pipeline (`runDispatch`, `pipeline.ts:746`) requires both `model` and `backend` (typed required on `DispatchOpts`), per s3-rulings.md ruling 1.

- **Explicit** (`resolveModelFromConfig`): loads both tables; missing slug/backend → `MODEL_NOT_FOUND` with `available` list; `available_on` mismatch → **warn only** (ruling 1, tables independently edited); pi-family backend with `null` base_url → `BAD_RECORD` refusal (line 185); `serving.context_window < 32768` → `BAD_RECORD` (line 194); absent `wiki/.dispatch/` dir → valid-empty maps → ordinary `MODEL_NOT_FOUND`. Threads `effort_mapping` (the capability declaration, WK-0122) and `request_params`.

### Tier 4 — golden fixture (DEC-0009; T33 capture-at-gate pattern)

- [ ] The Pi gate run's captured worker stream checked in unedited as
      `tests/fixtures/pi-output-explore-code.jsonl` (convention:
      `pi-output-code-review.jsonl`) with a parse test asserting the extracted
      verdict and recovery-block facts (role, outcome)
- [ ] (Capture-before-code cannot apply to a mode that does not exist yet;
      capture-at-gate is the ratified sequencing, as T33 did for compaction events.
      The fixture is thereafter the drift detector.)

## Evidence

### Current mode system (kb)

- `ModeParts` interface (`assemble.ts:122-129`) already captures per-mode data shape:
  `{introLine, framing, includeWriteScope, includeAcceptance, includeValidation, responseFormat}`
- `getModeParts()` (`assemble.ts:202-254`) is a 4-branch switch returning `ModeParts`
- `deriveVerdict()` (`capture.ts:414-461`) is a 4-branch ladder with per-mode logic
- `pipeline.ts` mode gates all key on `mode === 'implement'` vs everything else —
  the pipeline binary is already clean
- Advisory path (`pipeline.ts:1623-1639`) handles all non-implement modes identically:
  skip delivery, check for stray mutations, `delivery = 'no_changes'`

### Upstream comparison (AgentChassis)

AgentChassis has the **same scatter problem** — adding a role touches 8-13 files
(`ROLE_GUARD_ROLES`, `BACKEND_ACCEPTED_ROLES`, `AGENT_ROLE_RESULT_ROLES`, role guide
markdown, `PROFILE_DEFINITIONS`, `ALLOWED_MODES`, `WRAPPERS`, tool-access JSON, CLI
command, TOML config, contract renderer, result schema). Not config-driven either.

Key structural differences from kb:
- AgentChassis uses **worktrees** and allows implement workers to **commit** directly.
  kb clones, lets the worker edit, and the **host captures/commits** post-run.
- AgentChassis verdict is binary: worker (commit-based) vs reviewer/redteam (shared
  `deriveBackendReviewResult`). Redteam aliases to reviewer for policy.
- AgentChassis has no `research` or `explore_code` equivalent — those are kb-original.

These differences mean kb's verdict and pipeline logic is not a direct mirror of
AgentChassis's, and the right abstraction for kb may differ from upstream's binary split.

# PLN-0004 S3 — Rulings (operator-ratified 2026-09-07..10, frozen 2026-09-10) The nine open S3 decisions (D0–D8), walked and ruled in `execution/s3-open-decisions.md` (full options/facts/rationale live THERE; this doc is the binding freeze + build decomposition). The build has NOT started — the S3 execution session cold-starts from the tracker plus this file. Code facts below verified by a 2-subagent read-only sweep of `main` (post-S1/S2 state) on 2026-09-10. ## Rulings (net effect — supersessions already applied) 1. **Two-table repo-local registry; explicit `--model --backend `, both required (D0/D2).** `wiki/.dispatch/` in the consuming repo holds `models.json` (slug → available_on → per-backend model_id, + notes), `backends.json` (name → base_url, api_key_env|null, secrets_file|null, + notes), `profiles.json` (schema_version 1 + inject profiles). ALL ship blank (`{}` / `{"schema_version":1}`); kb ships NO seed entries — a kb-managed README carries copy-pasteable examples. `available_on` mismatch = warn, never refuse. Malformed models/backends JSON = loud refusal at dispatch naming file + parse error; malformed profiles.json refuses credentialed dispatches only. Absent dir/files = valid empty state, guidance names `init-dispatch`. Multi-backend models: MCP instructions say ask the operator — no defaulting. 2. **Model keys are backend-owned infrastructure (D0).** Injection is SELECTIVE: only the resolved backend's `api_key_env` (from its `secrets_file`) plus granted profiles' `inject` vars reach the worker. The S0 blanket `set -a; source secrets.env` block (pipeline.ts:199-204) is retired. HO `credentials:` = task credentials only; model keys never trip the credentials+web hard stop. 3. **No preflight probes (D1).** kb never executes credential commands. Declarative existence checks only: profile exists in profiles.json, inject var present in its named file (checked Linux-side, reported set/unset, value never printed), refusing `CREDENTIAL_NOT_CONFIGURED` / `UNKNOWN_PROFILE` pre-spawn. Liveness is the orchestrator/operator's job; MCP instructions say so. 4. **profiles.json IS the policy (D3).** No policy file. `UNKNOWN_PROFILE` lands at S3. `MODE_NOT_ALLOWED_FOR_PROFILE` is DROPPED — superseded by D8's removal of `allowed_modes` (no field to key off); the credentials+web hard stop (`CREDENTIALS_WITH_WEB`, spec §7.6) covers the real case. Spec §7.7 / S4 14-check count delta recorded in the tracker (T14 note). 5. **profiles.json schema frozen (D8).** `schema_version: 1`; profile = `{ "inject": { "VAR_NAME": "/path/to/file" } }`. Strict validation: unknown keys refuse, naming the key. New handoff field `vars` (non-secret literal env for the worker — contract addition; refuse on any `vars` key colliding with an injected/api_key var name). No `mounts`, no `allowed_modes`, no `preflight` in profiles. `data_mounts` = non-credential data only (S5 enforcement). 6. **Cloud credential isolation = operator-mediated short-lived creds; kb stays cloud-ignorant (D8, 2026-09-10).** `aws configure export-credentials --profile

--format env-no-export > <0600 file outside every repo>` → plain `inject` profile. `--profile` pins the named non-superuser profile; the no-profile default chain (on EC2, the instance role) is also acceptable when used deliberately. GCP later: `gcloud auth print-access-token`, same shape. No INI/SSO-cache parsing, no STS calls in kb, ever; STS hardening stays spec §15-deferred (trigger: first real AWS/GCP need — planned work-surface test via cloned kb on already-bootstrapped repos). 7. **Version gate (D5).** In-code harness constant `{package: '@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent', testedWith: '0.85.1', knownGood, installCmd}` — kb's only compatibility claim, shipped with kb code, NOT a `wiki/.dispatch` file (post-D2 amendment). `PI_VERSION=$(pi --version)` rides the existing preflight script (KEY=value convention); below knownGood → refuse printing installCmd; above testedWith → warn + proceed + stamp; unprobeable/unparseable → refuse (fail-closed). Add npm `semver` (absent from the dep tree — sweep-verified). 8. **Backend fingerprint (D5, confirmed).** Best-effort `curl -m 2` against the run's resolved base_url (Ollama `/api/version`, vLLM `/version`, else host+model only) rides the execution script → run state → response-doc provenance. Facts-only, never gating. Provenance stamps RESOLVED runtime values (actual base_url/model_id/backend — retires the `{{WIN_HOST}}` template leak). 9. **`EFFORT_UNSUPPORTED` + refusal-code codegen land at S3 (D7).** Thread `effort` through DispatchOpts (controller currently discards it — dispatch-controller-entry.ts:243); provided + unsupported model → synchronous refusal pre-spawn (both current open-model entries refuse; codex/claude honor it at S6). Export a `V2_REFUSAL_CODES` const (typed against `DispatchErrorCode`) as the single source for the gate, the MCP instructions list, and a pinning test — the hand-list in create-server.ts:61-64 (which advertises the nonexistent code and omits 7 real ones) dies. Dated tracker delta on S1 (its effort-refusal gate step cannot have run as specced). 10. **S3 gate = HF positive proof + refusal legs (D6).** Operator's EXISTING HF token; AWS-positive leg deferred (trigger in ruling 6). Honesty: the HF proof rides pre-S5 open egress (§16.6) and is not repeatable post-S5 (hard stop forbids credentials+web) — a one-time gate proof. OpenRouter key exposure is unchanged from today and rotates on the operator's 7-day cadence. 11. **`init-dispatch` is a NEW tool beside v1 (D2 + freeze correction).** Creates `wiki/.dispatch/` + blank tables + README (kb-managed markers; re-run refreshes the managed section only, never user JSON). It does NOT stamp AGENTS.md or `.mcp.json` — sweep found both are already wiki-core bootstrap/sync jobs that cover kb-dispatch (mcp-config.ts writeMcpConfig; agent-instructions.ts writeManagedBlock). v1 `init-config` (token.key/launchers.v1.json) is untouched until S7. 12. **MCP instructions stay static, no I/O (S1 ruling 8 preserved).** Drop the hardcoded model list; point at `/wiki/.dispatch/` tables + "run `init-dispatch` to scaffold"; add the D1 credential-liveness guidance. The refusal-code list is codegen'd from `V2_REFUSAL_CODES` (ruling 9). D2's "rewire to read the merged registry" is amended to "point at the repo tables" — the server serves any `dir`, so it cannot read one repo's tables at startup. ## Freeze-session corrections (code-fact-driven, 2026-09-10) - **Selective injection is SCRIPT-SIDE (Linux), not launcher-side.** s0 ruling 5's invariant stands: secret values exist only Linux-side, never in Windows process memory, never in script text. The generated script exports only the resolved var names by reading their named files in-shell (e.g. `export VAR="$(grep -m1 '^VAR=' | cut -d= -f2-)"`); `vars` literals are plain export lines (non-secret, collision-gated). - **Injected-value delivery scan (T6's "patterns-only until S3" delta) reports var NAMES, never values.** The WSL2-side enumerate script greps the diff for the resolved values and emits boolean hits (`SECRET_HIT=`); the TS verdict consumes names only. Live-gate seeding of a value-bearing diff is flaky (prompt-injection theater) — the injected-value scan is proven at the fake tier; the pattern scan is already S0-live-proven. Stated here so the gap is loud, not silent. - **MODE_NOT_ALLOWED_FOR_PROFILE dropped** (ruling 4) — D8 postdates D3 and removed the field it keyed off. - **New codes at S3:** `EFFORT_UNSUPPORTED`, `CREDENTIALS_WITH_WEB`, `UNKNOWN_PROFILE`, `CREDENTIAL_NOT_CONFIGURED` (join the 13 existing v2 codes in errors.ts). ## Explicitly OUT of S3 (scope closed) - Mounts/egress enforcement, `--clearenv`, tunnel — S5 (jail passes ambient env + full network through; honesty comments land at S3, mechanism at S5). - `data_mounts` runtime consumption — S5. Advisory modes, `blocked` plumbing, framings — S6 (T30). `create-handoff` §5 schema migration — S7 (T8 delta). - AWS/GCP positive proof — deferred (ruling 6; both tested on work compute via cloned kb). STS-minted scoped creds — spec §15. - Rich model catalog (bioinfo models, quantization/RAM notes) + generation params (max_tokens/temperature/timeout) — future slice (D2 deferral); needs a tracker item. ## Build decomposition (execution session — ≤4 sonnet subagents, 3 waves) Branch `feat/dispatch-v2-s3` off `main`; merge or delete same-session (s0 ruling 6). Tracker Critical Rules bind; v1 tool surface and tests untouched throughout. **Wave 1 — foundation (one agent).** `errors.ts`: four new codes + `V2_REFUSAL_CODES` export. `repo-config.ts` (NEW): types + loaders + strict validation for the three `wiki/.dispatch/` tables per rulings 1/5 (absent = valid empty; malformed semantics per ruling 1). Contract: `vars` added to manifest HO `optionalFrontMatter` + template comment; `ho.ts` parses `vars` (string→string). Unit tests (new `dispatch-v2-config.test.ts` + foundation extensions). May run full typecheck+test. **Wave 2 — two agents in parallel, disjoint files; pure modules only, NO pipeline.ts / MCP / CLI edits (wave 3 wires).** - *Credentials leg:* `credentials.ts` (NEW): profile resolution against repo-config; `UNKNOWN_PROFILE` / `CREDENTIAL_NOT_CONFIGURED` / `CREDENTIALS_WITH_WEB` checks; vars-collision check; builders for the script-side selective-injection export lines and the Linux-side existence-check fragment; injected-value scan fragment for the enumerate script (names-only reporting) + `capture.ts` `credentials_granted` = granted names (replaces the `[]` stub at capture.ts:210). Unit tests (`dispatch-v2-credentials.test.ts`). - *Registry/version leg:* `model-registry.ts` rewrite: two-table `resolveModel(dir, slug, backend)` → resolved entry; harness constant + semver version gate (consumed by preflight); `PI_VERSION` line + parse in `preflight.ts`; backend-fingerprint script fragment + parse; effort-support fact on the resolved entry (for `EFFORT_UNSUPPORTED`). Unit tests (foundation/e2e extensions). **Wave 3 — surface + integration (one agent).** `pipeline.ts`: credential checks join the synchronous gate (after `checkAdmission`, before spawn — S1 ruling 2 order); selective-injection block replaces pipeline.ts:199-204; fingerprint fragment into the execution script; `effort`/`backend` threaded through DispatchOpts → controller argv → dispatch-background (controller's `void parsedArgv.effort` dies); resolved-value provenance. MCP: `dispatch` schema gains required `backend` + `effort` refusal; NEW `init-dispatch` tool `{dir, force?}` (ruling 11) + CLI verb; instructions rebuild (ruling 12) + `V2_REFUSAL_CODES` pinning test; annotation sets + interface-smoke 11 → 12. Incidental stale-comment cleanup (D7.4) in touched files. e2e fake-tier: credentialed happy path + one test per new refusal code. Full `npm run typecheck && npm test` on Windows AND WSL2 (cross-platform gate). ## Live gate sequence (after the build; operator ratifies each leg) 1. `init-dispatch` against test_kb → `wiki/.dispatch/` scaffold (blank tables + README); edit a user line, re-run, edit preserved + managed section refreshed. Commit (tracked wiki dirties test_kb by design). 2. Operator fills: `backends.json` (openrouter: api_key_env OPENROUTER_API_KEY + secrets_file path; ollama: null key), `models.json` (deepseek → openrouter model_id `deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-0731`; qwen3:8b → ollama), `profiles.json` (`hf` inject → existing HF-token file path, 0600, outside the repo). Commit. 3. Dispatch HO-0005 (frozen draft below) `--model deepseek --backend openrouter` → `completed`; delivery clean (token never in diff); response provenance shows `credentials_granted: ["hf"]`, resolved base_url/model_id/backend, PI_VERSION, backend fingerprint. 4. Refusal proofs (all synchronous, nothing spawned): HO naming a missing profile → `UNKNOWN_PROFILE`; hf var absent from its inject file → `CREDENTIAL_NOT_CONFIGURED`; `credentials: ["hf"]` + `web: true` → `CREDENTIALS_WITH_WEB`; `--effort high` → `EFFORT_UNSUPPORTED`; malformed profiles.json + credentialed HO → refusal while an uncredentialed HO still dispatches; malformed backends.json → refusal naming the file; missing `--backend` → usage/`MODEL_NOT_FOUND`. 5. Version-gate semantics (refuse-below / warn-above / fail-closed) are fake-tier proven; the live leg is the provenance stamp in HO-0005's response doc. 6. Operator ratifies → tick S3 gate, flip status row, Completed Log entry, schema friction notes. ### `wiki/handoffs/HO-0005.md` (frozen draft — test_kb; dispatch `--model deepseek --backend openrouter`) ```markdown --- id: HO-0005 title: Add an HF whoami credential check script with node:test coverage mode: implement write_scope: ["scripts/", "test/"] base_ref: null web: false credentials: ["hf"] data_mounts: [] read_first: ["README.md"] acceptance: - "AC-1: scripts/hf-whoami-check.mjs exits 0 when env HF_TOKEN holds a valid token: GET https://huggingface.co/api/whoami-v2 with 'Authorization: Bearer', asserting HTTP 200 and a non-empty name field; the token value is never printed or written" - "AC-2: exits 1 with a clear one-line error when HF_TOKEN is unset or the API returns non-200" - "AC-3: `node --test test/` passes with fetch stubbed (no live call in tests), covering AC-1 logic, AC-2 both branches" validation: ["node --test test/", "node scripts/hf-whoami-check.mjs"] status: draft --- ## Context test_kb is a minimal knowledge-base repo with no build system. Node 22 is available; there is no package.json and you must not create one — use ES modules, built-in fetch, and the built-in node:test runner only. HF_TOKEN is provided in your environment; treat it as secret — never echo, log, or write its value anywhere. ## Relevant files - README.md — repo purpose (read only) ## Task 1. Create `scripts/hf-whoami-check.mjs` per AC-1/AC-2. 2. Create `test/hf-whoami-check.test.mjs` with node:test + node:assert, fetch stubbed. 3. Run `node --test test/` until green, then run the live check once (`node scripts/hf-whoami-check.mjs`) and confirm exit 0. ## Constraints - Touch only `scripts/` and `test/`. No package.json, no dependencies, no config files. - Decision space: none granted (rev-5 framing) — implement exactly the specified behavior; a missing decision is a `blocked` exit naming what you need. ``` Note: the live-check validation leg works only pre-S5 (open egress) — see ruling 10. ## Operator prep (before the live gate; kb never does these) 1. Put the existing HF token in a 0600 file outside every repo (WSL2 ext4), one line: `HF_TOKEN=…`. Note the path for `profiles.json`. 2. Confirm `~/.config/kb-dispatch/secrets.env` still holds `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` (unchanged; `backends.json` will point `secrets_file` at it). 3. Ollama leg unchanged (no secret); `OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0` only if a qwen3:8b run is exercised this gate.

Exploration complete. Here are my structured findings.

---

# Explorer report — HO-0082: model-registry.ts public API and resolution logic

**Subject:** `packages/dispatch-core/src/model-registry.ts` (474 lines) — dispatch v2 two-table model registry (PLN-0004 S3 Wave 2b), harness version gate, backend fingerprint.

**Verdict:** The module is in good shape and well-tested (46/46 targeted tests pass live). Findings are non-blocking: 2 low + 2 info.

## 1. Public API surface

**Types** (all exported from the module; `ModelEntry`/`ModelRegistry`/`ResolvedModel`/`VersionGateResult`/`BackendFingerprint` re-exported from the `index.ts` barrel):
- `ModelEntry` / `ModelRegistry` (line 26/40) — legacy S0 seed shape, still consumed as a *type* by `adapters/pi.ts`, `environment.ts`, `pipeline.ts`.
- `ResolvedModel` (line 101) — `{slug, backend, family, modelId, baseUrl, apiKeyEnv, secretsFile, availableOn, effortMapping?, contextWindow, requestParams?}`.
- `VersionGateResult` (`ok|warn|refuse`), `BackendFingerprint` (`{serverVersion, host, model}`).

**Constants:** `DEFAULT_CONTEXT_WINDOW = 131072` (line 126), `MIN_CONTEXT_WINDOW = 32768` (line 137, = 2× Pi's 16384 compaction reserve, verified against Pi 0.85.1 `compaction.js:160-163`), `PI_HARNESS_INFO = {package: '@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent', testedWith: '0.85.1', knownGood: '0.85.0', installCmd}`.

**Functions:**
| Export | Purpose | Barrel? |
|---|---|---|
| `getDefaultRegistry()`, `resolveModel(registry, alias)` | S0 seed, deprecated | yes |
| `resolveModelFromConfig(dir, slug, backend)` | explicit two-table resolution | yes |
| `resolveModelByMode(dir, mode)` | both flags omitted → `use_for` mode default | yes |
| `resolveModelInferBackend(dir, slug)` | model-only → infer sole backend | **no** |
| `gatePiPresence(family, piVersion, installCmd?)` | refuse pi-family with pi missing | **no** |
| `checkHarnessVersion(versionString)` | version gate (fails closed) | yes |
| `buildFingerprintFragment(resolvedModel)`, `parseFingerprintOutput(stdout)` | backend probe (never gating) | yes |

## 2. Resolution logic — default vs explicit dispatch

`dispatch-background.ts:231-256` implements the precedence ladder: **explicit wins → model-only infers backend → both omitted resolves by HO `mode` → backend-only errors `BAD_RECORD`** showing a usage message. The direct pipeline (`runDispatch`, `pipeline.ts:746`) requires both `model` and `backend` (typed required on `DispatchOpts`), per s3-rulings.md ruling 1.

- **Explicit** (`resolveModelFromConfig`): loads both tables; missing slug/backend → `MODEL_NOT_FOUND` with `available` list; `available_on` mismatch → **warn only** (ruling 1, tables independently edited); pi-family backend with `null` base_url → `BAD_RECORD` refusal (line 185); `serving.context_window < 32768` → `BAD_RECORD` (line 194); absent `wiki/.dispatch/` dir → valid-empty maps → ordinary `MODEL_NOT_FOUND`. Threads `effort_mapping` (the capability declaration, WK-0122) and `request_params`.
- **Mode default** (`resolveModelByMode`): collects (slug, backend) pairs where `use_for` includes the mode AND the backend exists in backends.json; 0 → `NO_MODEL_DEFAULT`, >1 → `AMBIGUOUS_MODEL_DEFAULT`, exactly 1 → delegates to `resolveModelFromConfig`.
- **Infer backend** (`resolveModelInferBackend`): `available_on` length 1 → resolve; not 1 → `AMBIGUOUS_BACKEND`. Note: models.json validation does not require non-empty `available_on`, and the tests pin zero-entry as `AMBIGUOUS_BACKEND`, not success.

**Live gate fact (relevant to WK-0183 Tier 3):** the repo's own `wiki/.dispatch/models.json` uses `use_for` = `implement`/`code_review`/`redteam` only — **no `explore_code` default exists**, so mode-default resolution for `explore_code` returns `NO_MODEL_DEFAULT`. This is exactly why WK-0183 Tier 3 mandates explicit `--model`/`--backend` on gate dispatches (HO-0064 F5); the dispatch orchestrator resolving this HO via fallback rules would fail. Explicit flags are required.

## 3. Findings

- **F1 (low)** — **Barrel omits 4 public module symbols.** `index.ts:228-236` re-exports only `ResolvedModel`, `VersionGateResult`, `BackendFingerprint`, `PI_HARNESS_INFO`, `resolveModelFromConfig`, `resolveModelByMode`, `checkHarnessVersion`, `buildFingerprintFragment`, `parseFingerprintOutput`. Missing: `resolveModelInferBackend`, `gatePiPresence`, `DEFAULT_CONTEXT_WINDOW`, `MIN_CONTEXT_WINDOW` — the first two are still consumed by sibling packages via direct module import (`dispatch-background.ts:25`, `pipeline.ts:41`). Consumers of the `@kb/dispatch-core` barrel can't reach these. Internal-only today, so cosmetic, but inconsistent with the barrel's own claim to be the public surface.
- **F2 (low)** — **`base_url` is URL-shape-unvalidated for the pi family.** `repo-config.ts` validates only string-or-null; `resolveModelFromConfig` refuses `null`+pi but passes any non-null string. A garbage/empty `base_url: ""` on a pi backend resolves `ok`, then throws an **uncaught `TypeError` from `new URL()`** at `buildPiBaseUrl` (`pipeline.ts:1796`, reached at `pipeline.ts:1011`) instead of a structured `BAD_RECORD` refusal. The module's own philosophy ("loud refusal naming the file") is violated for this input class. Fix: shape-check the URL (e.g., `new URL()` try/catch) in `resolveModelFromConfig` alongside the null check at line 185.
- **F3 (info)** — **In-clone `npm run typecheck` fails at base 3a55df4 with a clean working tree** (TS6305: `packages/wiki-core/dist/date.d.ts` not built, plus cascading TS7006s across package sources and tests). Full suite is unrun. This looks like a clone build-cache artifact (`dist/` absent), unrelated to model-registry, but it affects the HO's `validation: npm run typecheck && npm test` gate — needs a clean-checkout confirmation before the gate is counted green.
- **F4 (info)** — **Stale doc comment.** Module header says the S0 section is kept because "pipeline.ts and adapters/pi.ts still import this shape; Wave 3 switches the pipeline import to resolveModelFromConfig and removes this section" — Wave 3 already landed; `resolveModelFromConfig` is the live pipeline import (line 746), and `getDefaultRegistry`/`resolveModel` now have **no runtime importers outside tests** (foundation/e2e fake-tier). Only the `ModelEntry` *type* is still consumed. Deprecation comment is stale.

**Minor observations (no finding):** the `context_window < MIN_CONTEXT_WINDOW` gate applies to all families but its message is Pi-flavored (harmless — codex/claude default to 131072); fingerprint probe `grep|cut` with no match yields an empty (not `"unknown"`) `_FP_VERSION`, but `parseFingerprintOutput` normalizes `''` → `null` so downstream is safe; the `buildFingerprintFragment` T33 `baseUrl: null` fallback (kind `'other'`, `_FP_HOST` = backend name) is handled for codex/claude.

## Live evidence

- `npx vitest run tests/dispatch-v2-registry.test.ts tests/dispatch-v2-explore-code.test.ts` → **46/46 pass** (all resolver paths, harness gate, fingerprint emit/parse covered).
- No files modified (`git status` clean at base 3a55df4).
